pages.title: Silver the Hedgehog Levitating a Circle of Large Rocks with Telekinesis Coloring Page
pages.description: Silver levitates a circle of large rocks with telekinesis in this printable coloring page, hovering with both palms spread toward the viewer above fractured ground. Four broad boulders and many smaller fragments orbit his upright quills, and curved motion marks connect the floating stones around his gloved hands.

pages.title: Silver the Hedgehog Diverting a Falling Meteor While Tails Watches From Safety Coloring Page
pages.description: Silver diverts a falling meteor while Tails watches from safety in this printable coloring page, raising an open palm beneath the cratered rock and its curved trail. Tails stands on a separate rocky ledge behind him, with twin tails spread and both gloves held near his chest.

pages.title: Silver the Hedgehog Shielding a Chao From Falling Rubble with a Psychic Barrier Coloring Page
pages.description: Silver shields a Chao from falling rubble with a psychic barrier in this printable coloring page, holding both palms outward beneath an arched energy outline. Large broken rocks remain above the dome, while the seated Chao clasps its hands near its face beside Silver's boots on the cracked ground.

pages.title: Super Silver the Hedgehog Transforming with the Seven Chaos Emeralds Around Him Coloring Page
pages.description: Super Silver transforms among seven Chaos Emeralds in this printable coloring page, hovering with clenched gloves and tall quills as curved energy wisps surround the gems. The balanced arrangement places faceted jewels around his head and boots, with small glove bands and shoe panels adding detail to the central figure.

pages.title: Silver the Hedgehog as Sir Galahad in Knight Armor Holding His Sword Upright Coloring Page
pages.description: Silver appears as Sir Galahad in knight armor in this printable coloring page, holding an upright sword with an ornate guard beside his tall fan-shaped quills. Layered shoulder plates, diamond emblems, fitted gauntlets, and angular knee guards create smaller sections around his chest tuft and broad armored boots.

pages.title: Silver the Hedgehog as Sir Galahad Crossing Swords with Shadow as Sir Lancelot Coloring Page
pages.description: Silver as Sir Galahad crosses swords with Shadow as Sir Lancelot in this printable coloring page, with both armored figures beneath a round stone arch. Their long blades meet above decorated chest plates and flowing capes, while square paving stones and distant castle turrets complete the courtyard scene.

pages.title: Silver the Hedgehog Catching Sonic in a Telekinetic Hold in Soleanna Coloring Page
pages.description: Silver catches Sonic in a telekinetic hold in Soleanna in this printable coloring page, extending one palm toward the airborne hedgehog above a canal-side walkway. A double wavy outline surrounds Sonic's bent legs and clenched gloves, while an arched bridge and windowed buildings form the city backdrop.

pages.title: Silver the Hedgehog and Amy Rose Exploring the Ancient Passages of Dusty Desert Coloring Page
pages.description: Silver and Amy Rose explore Dusty Desert's ancient passages in this printable coloring page, with Silver pointing ahead as Amy steps through a cracked stone arch. Receding doorways draw the corridor into the background, and a carved pillar, scattered blocks, and uneven floor tiles add detail around their full-body poses.

pages.title: Silver the Hedgehog and Knuckles Exploring an Ancient Echidna Village Coloring Page
pages.description: Silver and Knuckles explore an ancient echidna village in this printable coloring page, looking toward a large carved figure on a cracked wall beside them. Silver raises a glove to his chin, while ruined arches, decorated stone steps, and a round building with triangular trim surround the two characters.

pages.title: Silver the Hedgehog Celebrating a Team Vector Racing Victory with Blaze and Vector Coloring Page
pages.description: Silver celebrates a Team Vector racing victory with Blaze and Vector in this printable coloring page, standing on the highest podium block with one fist raised. Confetti falls around the three smiling figures, and Vector's headphones and chain and Blaze's tufted cuffs add smaller details beside Silver's tall quills.

pages.title: Silver the Hedgehog Driving His Lightron Race Car Around a Sharp Turn Coloring Page
pages.description: Silver steers his Lightron race car around a sharp turn in this printable coloring page, gripping the wheel above the low vehicle's pointed central nose. Broad curved fenders surround large wheels, while a segmented track curb, rear fins, and curved motion marks emphasize the bend beside the guardrail.

pages.title: Silver the Hedgehog Wearing Round Glasses and Reading in the Ruined Kingdom Valley Library Coloring Page
pages.description: Silver wears round glasses while reading in the ruined Kingdom Valley library in this printable coloring page, seated on cracked steps with a large open book. Shelved volumes and a nearby book stack add rectangular patterns, and a broken arched window reveals distant tower shapes behind his tall quills.

pages.title: Silver the Hedgehog Delivering Letters Along the Canals of Soleanna Coloring Page
pages.description: Silver delivers letters along Soleanna's canals in this printable coloring page, placing an envelope into a rounded mailbox while holding several more against his chest. An arched bridge crosses the water behind him, with a moored boat, striped post, and domed buildings filling the canal-side setting.

pages.title: Silver the Hedgehog Dressed as Santa Levitating a Present Beside a Sleeping Chao Coloring Page
pages.description: Silver dresses as Santa and levitates a present beside a sleeping Chao in this printable coloring page, holding both hands around a floating ribbon-wrapped box. His pom-pom hat and trimmed coat add soft-edged shapes, while the curled Chao rests near his boots beside a small tree and rolling snowy ground.

pages.title: Silver the Hedgehog Wearing a Waiter Apron and Levitating a Serving Tray at the Chao Garden Cafe Coloring Page
pages.description: Silver wears a waiter apron and levitates a serving tray at the Chao Garden Cafe in this printable coloring page, holding one palm beneath the floating dish. A teacup and small Chao sit on the tray, with a flower-topped table, curved chair, gazebo, and palm tree completing the outdoor cafe.

pages.title: Silver the Hedgehog Celebrating Sonic's Birthday Beside a Cake with Sonic and Blaze Coloring Page
pages.description: Silver celebrates Sonic's birthday with Sonic and Blaze in this printable coloring page, clapping beside a round cake topped with lit candles on a small table. Blaze holds her hands together opposite him, while Sonic smiles between them; scalloped icing, candle stripes, and tufted cuffs add smaller details around the figures.
